objections.claim: The amended DR-006 route contains a false measured claim: 'v9 and every earlier head REJECTED'. EIR v6's independent review is ACCEPT AS A CANDIDATE with 0 blockers — not a rejection.
objections.evidence: Verdict census of every on-disk evidence-identity-recipes review: v1 REJECT/2, v2 REJECT/2, v3 REJECT/3, v4 REJECT/1, v5 REJECT/2, v6 'ACCEPT AS A CANDIDATE -- 0 BLOCKERS' (evidence-identity-recipes.v6.review-independent.json, sha256 7a0d93e4…), v7 REJECT/1, v8 REJECT/1, v9 REJECT/1. A register entry whose ethos is 'completion is an evidence state, not a declaration' cannot carry a lineage assertion falsified by the lineage's own retained bytes.
objections.proposedFix: Correct the parenthetical to the measured facts: 'v1–v5 and v7–v9 REJECTED; v6 accepted as candidate-only (0 blockers) and superseded without application; v10 under review at amendment, since REJECTED (1 blocker).'

objections.claim: DR-006's binding property — 'the lineage head whose review returns 0 blockers' — is too weak: a 0-blocker review can be candidate-only or expressly reserve application, and executing the property literally would re-admit exactly the promotion MF-3 struck for R04.
objections.evidence: Three corpus precedents, one inside this very lineage: (a) EIR v6 — 0 blockers, ACCEPT AS A CANDIDATE, never applied, followed by four more rejected heads; (b) delivery.v5 — 0 blockers, 'EXPRESSLY NOT FOR APPLICATION', §7.1 disqualifier standing; (c) r1 v1.9 — ACCEPT-AS-CANDIDATE with applyRecommendation DO-NOT-APPLY-UNTIL-CORPUS-RESOLVER-CHECK. '0 blockers' and 'lawful to apply' are measurably different states in this corpus, and the DR-002 acceptance note already records the general rule ('a PASSED with a DO-NOT-SEAL recommendation is not an application warrant').
objections.proposedFix: Strengthen the property: 'the lineage head whose independent review returns 0 blockers AND grants application-grade acceptance with no express reservation (candidate-only, DO-NOT-SEAL-blocking-apply, or DO-NOT-APPLY-UNTIL-X verdicts do not qualify), followed by coordinator apply per route A.' Consider stating it once as the standing acceptance property for ALL route-A entries, since the same hazard recurs at R04, R09, and any future lineage.

objections.claim: R09's route ('v1.9 application (gated as DR-009) plus retained-validator standing and CIR-B1 closure') version-pins v1.9 against the just-adopted head-relative rule, and omits the artifact's own express apply-condition chain.
objections.evidence: r1-lifetime-neutrality.conformance.v1.9.review-independent.json (3914c9c5…): recommendation ACCEPT-AS-CANDIDATE, sealRecommendation DO-NOT-SEAL, applyRecommendation DO-NOT-APPLY-UNTIL-CORPUS-RESOLVER-CHECK. The discharge chain exists but is stateful: corpus-resolution.v1 (3aff78f1…) outcome REFUSED-BY-BOTH-INSTRUMENTS; corpus-resolution.v2 (f79ccd04…) outcome POSITIVE-UNDER-BOTH-INSTRUMENTS with the standing caveat that the repaired instruments' review must be relied on — which D-001 itself gates behind DR-204 (§4 'reliance timing'). '(gated as DR-009)' encodes this only obliquely; 'v1.9 application' names none of it. This is the MF-3 pattern in miniature — a route text saying 'apply X' where X's review expressly conditions application — mitigated here because the discharge chain exists on disk and is partially referenced.
objections.proposedFix: Reword R09 head-relatively and name the chain: 'R09 R-1: application of the reviewed conformance head (v1.9 at this amendment) only through its review's own apply condition — corpus-resolver check POSITIVE (corpus-resolution.v2) whose instrument-review reliance is DR-204-gated per DR-009 — plus retained-validator standing and CIR-B1 closure.'

objections.claim: R14 still carries the bare label 'mechanical' — the explicitly-named half of accepted objection ADV-D001-08 that was not implemented — while the entry states 'every objection accepted; none rebutted'.
objections.evidence: Amended §3: 'R14 RESOLVED-INPUTS stale-note reconciliation — mechanical.' Turn-1 ADV-D001-08's proposedFix read: 'Strike "mechanical" wherever the act still requires the coop process's review step (DR-001 re-record, R14).' The DR-001 half was implemented; the R14 half was not, with no recorded rebuttal. The stale note lives in resolved-inputs.v2.json — a V1 artifact — so its reconciliation locus determines whether route-A review applies; the register's own rule is that a V2-local edit cannot close an inherited V1 prerequisite. If the coordinator holds that R14's reconciliation is genuinely review-free, that is a rebuttal and must be recorded as one; the current 'none rebutted' claim is inaccurate while this stands silently.
objections.proposedFix: Either (a) state R14's reconciliation locus and review path ('V1-side note edit through route A' or 'register/matrix-side reconciliation recorded as a reviewed disposition'), striking or qualifying 'mechanical'; or (b) record an explicit rebuttal for the R14 half and amend the 'none rebutted' sentence.

objections.claim: SF-3's new-row rule is an interpretive gloss whose literal effect diverges from the byte-quoted checklist: the quotation fixes 'DR-101 through DR-127' while the rule evaluates the quantifier 'over the register as it stands at readiness evaluation'.
objections.evidence: Both texts now live in the same §, one quoted as verbatim-adopted, one glossing it. The gloss is exactly what turn-1 SF-3 requested and it is openly recorded, so this is not smuggling — but two normative texts that can diverge will eventually be read against each other.
objections.proposedFix: When C4a lands (the first new-row act), also amend file 08's condition-2 wording through the register's own reviewed process (e.g., 'all rows of the V2 architecture and product decisions table') so the owning document and the gloss cannot diverge; D-001 §6 already holds the register is the checklist's sole owner.

objections.claim: 'Quoted byte-for-byte' is exact at the word level but the blockquote re-wraps lines, so it is not literally byte-identical.
objections.evidence: Mechanical comparison under whitespace normalization returns EQUAL; raw bytes differ only in line-break positions and the '> ' blockquote prefix. No word, number, backtick span, or punctuation mark differs.
objections.proposedFix: Optional: say 'quoted word-for-word (blockquote re-wrapped)'. No substantive action required; recorded so the phrase cannot later be attacked as inaccurate.

consensusPosition: Twelve of fourteen turn-1 items are resolved and verified against bytes. The four actionable turn-2 items are surgical: one false parenthetical to correct (T2-01), one property clause to strengthen (T2-02), one route sentence to reword (T2-03), one label to fix or rebut on the record (T2-04). None reopens the definition of done itself, the routing architecture, the preference list, or the commit plan. If the coordinator's turn-3 amendment lands these four with the same fidelity as this amendment, this reviewer expects to CONSENT.
